description: 皮克防御 B07 — 超现代内爆：诱导白方扩张，e5反制

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Lesson 5: Pirc Defense
The hypermodern plan is to let White build a large center, then undermine it. When should Black strike with ...e5, and how can the position turn from passive defense into active counterplay?
intro.popup:
反制中心第5课

皮克防御！
超现代体系

先让白方建立强大中心
再瓦解它！

核心问题：
什么时候出击e5？
如何把被动转为主动？

outro.popup_en: The Pirc counterattack pattern: allow the opponent to expand, choose the right moment to break, then shift from defense to attack. Evaluate whether ...e5 opens the position, activates the bishop on g7, and improves the knights.
outro.popup:
皮克防御总结

超现代反制模式：
① 让对方中心扩张
② 找准时机爆破
③ 由守转攻

反制成功标志：
① e5爆破后局面开放？
② 象g7活跃度提升？
③ 马的活跃性如何？

moves.popup_en: ...d6 begins the Pirc Defense and its hypermodern setup.
moves.popup:
d6 皮克！
超现代体系

moves.popup_en: d4 gives White a strong central presence.
moves.popup: d4 白方建立强大中心

moves.popup_en: ...g6! Black follows the hypermodern principle and lets White expand first.
moves.popup:
g6 超现代！
让白方先扩张

moves.popup_en: ...Bg7! Black's fianchettoed bishop keeps the center under observation.
moves.popup:
Bg7！超现代象
虎视中心

moves.popup_en: ...c6 stabilizes Black's structure and prepares a later central break.
...e5! The central break arrives at the right moment, undermining White's center.
moves.popup:
e5！爆破时刻！
内爆白方中心

moves.popup_en: Bg5 puts pressure on Black's position.
...Nc5! Black's knight becomes active and contests key squares.
moves.popup:
Nc5！马激活
争夺关键格

moves.popup_en: Nc4 contests space and important squares.
...Ne6! Black's knight occupies an important outpost.
